name: Standard Notes Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Imports decrypted Standard Notes JSON backups with their native .txt filename.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
The destination folder setting shows a message under the field for an unsafe path.
Closing the settings stops a GitHub sign in that is still waiting for its code.
tip: Keep the original .txt backup name; renaming it to .json is not needed.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Standard Notes Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
